title: Level 1: Git soft-lease
description:
## Goal

Level 1: Git-based soft-lease so workers can announce claims through the same issue/event model. Git remains the only required communication mechanism.

## Constraints

- Contention windows and lease timing must accommodate Git latency (not MQTT-scale seconds unless Git has already converged).
- Concurrent workers remain allowed. Git provides conflict detection and eventual convergence, not an efficient distributed mutex.
- A Git-only install is fully functional.

## Depends on

Transport-independent protocol Gherkin under the protocol epic.

## Acceptance

Dual-runtime (Python + Rust) implements the Git lease provider against the Gherkin. Duplicate execution remains possible; that is acceptable at this level.
right_now_summary: The Git lease provider still needs implementation in Python and Rust.
